visual_action: A montage showing Donald Trump with a large group of young adults, presumably interns. They pose for a group photo inside an ornate room in the White House. Trump then shakes hands with them in a line outside on the White House grounds. The video includes a shot from inside a moving vehicle (likely a helicopter) as Trump waves out the window, looking back at the White House and the group of people on the lawn. The video ends with black and white footage of a helicopter taking off from the White House lawn, followed by a title card.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Shown throughout the video interacting with interns and in a helicopter leaving the White House.

cast.name: White House Internship Program
cast.evidence: The on-screen text explicitly names the "White House Internship Program" and encourages applications.

cast.name: Unnamed White House interns
cast.evidence: A large group of young adults are shown with Donald Trump at the White House, consistent with the theme of the internship program mentioned in the text.

on_screen_text.text: In your young adult years, someone will tell you about the White House Internship Program. It is very important that you apply.

spoken_summary: The audio consists of lyrics from the background song, Fleetwood Mac's "Silver Springs." The audible lyrics include "Time has a spell on you / But you won't forget me."
audio_music: The video is set to the song "Silver Springs" by Fleetwood Mac. The music is reflective and nostalgic, creating a sense of a significant, unforgettable memory.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage of different clips with smooth transitions. Some shots, like Trump looking out the helicopter window, appear to be in slow motion. The overall pacing is deliberate and cinematic.
central_claim: The White House Internship Program is an important, life-changing experience that young people should apply for.
intended_effect: To inspire young people to apply to the White House Internship Program by portraying it as a prestigious and memorable opportunity.
